messages:
Maya: Quick copy check for the Deployments empty state. Current header: 'No active deployments'. The body is 'Create a deployment to get started.' Feels bland. Suggestions?

Jin: I'd avoid 'Create a deployment' as the primary CTA copy 14 developers may be doing smaller actions like 'Add model' or 'Link repo'. Maybe make the CTA more action-oriented and specific to this context.

Priya: What about emphasizing the value: header 'No active deployments yet' and body 'Deploy a model to serve fast, reliable inference for your app.' CTA: 'Create deployment' or 'Start deployment'.

Ben: 'Start deployment' sounds like a flow. But could confuse non-technical PMs. Keep it plain: 'Create deployment' is clear. Also suggest an inline secondary link: 'See deployment guide' -> /docs/deployments/getting-started.

Maya: Accessibility note: the empty-state image is decorative; put alt="" and ensure the main explanatory text is real text for screen readers. Also add an aria-describedby from the CTA to the body text.

DesignBot: Tone/length check: shorten body so first sentence communicates value. Suggestion: 'Deploy a model to serve low-latency inference from Redwood.' CTA: primary 'Create deployment', secondary 'Deployment guide'. Contrast: ensure primary button meets AA on background.

Jin: Another microcopy tweak: tooltip for the 'create' button currently says 'Create'. Change to 'Create a deployment' so tooltip mirrors CTA and helps discoverability.

Priya: Draft strings for engineers/figma:

Header: "No active deployments yet"
Body: "Deploy a model to serve low-latency inference for your product."
Primary CTA: "Create deployment"
Secondary CTA: "Deployment guide"
Tooltip (button): "Create a deployment"

Ben: +1. Also add a small helper under the CTA for advanced users: 'Prefer CLI? Try `redwood deploy`' (inline code).

Maya: I'll update the Figma component and open a tiny PR with these strings. Will include ARIA notes in the component spec.

Priya: Thanks — tagging @Product for visibility and localization so they can review the shorter sentences for translation costs. :wave:

Ben: Nice. If anyone objects to 'Create deployment' vs 'Start deployment' speak up in this thread, otherwise I'll mark as accepted in the PR later today. :thumbsup:
